title: Normalize ExitNoRepo/ExitNotFound across all commands
description:
gyz-era audit finding, human-approved fix. ~15 commands (create, close, list, deps, graph, label, labels, gc, import, blocked, note, notes, show, update, reopen - audit ALL of cmd/tk/cmd/) wrap the identical repoRoot() failure as fmt.Errorf exit 1 instead of ExitError{ExitNoRepo}(3), and missing-tick lookups as 1 instead of ExitNotFound(4), while approve/reject/merge and the herd family already use the typed codes. An orchestrator cannot branch on "no repo"/"no such tick" reliably.

Fix: centralize — a helper that wraps repoRoot() failures in ExitNoRepo once (find where each command calls it; prefer fixing the shared entry point over 15 call sites), and audit every tick-lookup error path for ExitNotFound. Do NOT change which conditions are errors — only their exit classification. Every observable code change (1 -> 3 or 1 -> 4) gets a CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry with a one-line rationale, mirroring the 0.20.0 typed-exit-codes entry style. Tests: table over all affected commands pinning the new codes (in-process via ExecuteArgs; temp dirs, no real .tick); confirm approve/reject/merge/herd are untouched. Audit table (command -> paths -> old/new code) in your RESULT report. Full-suite gate on real exit codes per .tick/config.md Testing; gofmt/vet clean. Do NOT commit your RESULT file.
acceptance_criteria: Every command hitting no-repo exits 3 and missing-tick exits 4, pinned by a table-driven test; zero behavior changes beyond exit classification; CHANGELOG entries present; full suite green
